name: Create white matter mask from FA
summary: Creates a binary white matter mask in DWI space by thresholding a fractional anisotropy (FA) map with FSL fslmaths.
description: Thresholds the FA image at thr (default 0.15) and binarizes it into mask.nii.gz. Use it for a quick DWI-space white matter mask, e.g. for tractography seeding or masking; the FA threshold also keeps some non-white-matter voxels with high anisotropy and drops crossing-fiber regions with low FA.

inputs.description: Tensor output; only the FA map is used.

outputs.description: Binary mask (mask.nii.gz) of voxels with FA above the threshold, in DWI space.

parameters.description: FA value below which voxels are excluded from the white matter mask (fslmaths -thr).

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check derivatives and logs
failure_modes.fix: Check that the tensor input contains fa.nii.gz.
